t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Certain colors give out different amounts of mushrooms. Sometimes the amounts can change. When they do just pick another color until you find one that pays out a high amount of mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Keep track of the colors that gives out the most mushrooms. Remember them, but after awhile the payoff will go down. Randomly pick new colors to see the different payout from time to time.
